master.stop_all: Emergency stop - closes every valve immediately

card.empty_state: No zones configured yet. Edit this card to add your irrigation zones.

program_panel.title: Program Settings
program_panel.auto_advance_desc: Automatically move on to the next enabled zone
program_panel.reverse_desc: Run the zone sequence back to front
program_panel.multiplier_desc: Scales every zone's run time, e.g. for the season
program_panel.repeat_desc: How many extra times to repeat the whole program

card.locked_note: Mower isn't docked - irrigation controls are locked until it's home.

auto_detect.title: Auto-detect from entity prefix
auto_detect.hint: If your controller's entities all share a common prefix (e.g. {example}), enter it here and click detect to auto-fill zones and controller entities below. You can still edit everything afterwards.

controller.title: Controller entities
controller.secondary_hint: Adds a second button next to Start/Stop Program that calls automation.trigger on the entity above - e.g. an automation created from the Smart Irrigation Runner blueprint, so you can kick it off on demand instead of waiting for its normal trigger.

safety.title: Safety
safety.hint: If set, the master switch, zone tiles and Program Settings all lock whenever this mower's state isn't "docked" - stop-all always stays active. Leave empty to disable.
